reason: PR-11.5 expanded the Substrate SkillTrustRecord schema and architecture coverage registry. Skills Registry consumes that schema, so its contract lock must pin the new committed Substrate surface.
user_intent_alignment_summary: The user required intentional consumer lock refreshes after Substrate schema changes. The lock refresh keeps Skills Registry aligned with the trust-surface fields that PR-11.5 now extracts and diffs.
diff_review_summary: contracts.lock.json updates contract_sha, substrate_repo_commit_sha, generated_at, contract_surface_lock.surface_sha256, computed_from_commit, and included_files_manifest_sha256. No executable product logic changed in this file.
why_merge_not_sufficient: The lock represents a specific committed tree and surface hash; the prior and current pins are mutually exclusive.
replacement_justification: Leaving Skills Registry on the old surface would make its new trust-surface fields out of sync with Substrate schema authority and would fail contract-lock drift validation.
alternatives_considered: Keep the old lock. Rejected because SkillTrustRecord schema changed in the contract surface.
Use a working-tree hash. Rejected because consumer locks must use committed-tree provenance.
approver: Lowell Wong requested PR-11.5 pre-push governance hardening
